personality_one_liner: An authoritative, trustworthy, and premium e-services platform grounded in deep palm greens and warm sand neutrals.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Avoid dense layouts.

do's: Sticky header backgrounds over scrolling content

screens.name: Customer Dashboard (Home)
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen for users to quickly access top government/business services, view pending request status, and access the wallet.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a subtle brand-tinted pulse.
states.empty: N/A for home. For 'My Requests', use a document illustration + 'لا توجد طلبات حالية'.
states.error: Card displaying 'حدث خطأ في تحميل الخدمات' مع زر 'إعادة المحاولة' (Retry button).

screens.layout: Sticky header with user greeting and notification bell (glassmorphism). Top section features a hero/status card with gradient overlay. Below: 'Quick Access' horizontal scroll of categories (rounded icons in brandTertiary squares). Below: Vertical list of 'Recent Services' or 'My Pending Requests'.

screens.name: Service Request Form
screens.purpose: Dynamic form for customers to fill out requirements for a specific service (e.g., visa extension) with a clear sticky CTA.

states.error: Inline validation errors below inputs in 'error' color.

screens.layout: Single column vertical layout. Labels above inputs. Progress indicator if multi-step. Primary CTA 'إرسال الطلب' (Submit Request) is sticky at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView over a glass background.

screens.name: Wallet / Top-up
screens.purpose: Allow users to view balance and top up via card or subscription.
screens.layout: Large hero card at the top displaying current balance with abstract finance background image. Below: Two primary actions (Top-up, Withdraw). Below: List of recent transactions with dividers.

screens.name: Provider Dashboard
screens.purpose: Office dashboard to view and manage customer service requests.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with 'لا توجد طلبات جديدة'.
states.error: Failed to load requests error state.

screens.layout: Top metric cards (Pending, Completed). Vertical list of request cards showing customer name, service type, and status badge.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central control to approve providers, manage services, and oversee system health.
screens.layout: Grid of management categories (Providers, Services, Users). Clicking one opens a list view with inline approve/reject actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the NO BLUE/PURPLE color rule. The primary brand color is deep Palm Green (#046C4E) to convey government/official trust in the Middle East.
Implement Arabic RTL direction logically. Ensure you use `margin-inline-start`, `padding-inline-end`, and `I18nManager.forceRTL(true)`. Align text to the right by default.

Use 'Tajawal' as the default font. Arabic UI needs slightly larger text. Use the 'lg' (16px) or 'xl' (20px) tokens for primary body/reading text rather than 'base' (14px) to ensure readability, as Arabic glyphs are smaller than Latin equivalents.
Do not add letter spacing to Arabic text (keep letter-spacing: 0). Use a line-height of 1.6 to 1.8.
When rendering images with text overlays (like the wallet balance or home hero card), you MUST apply the top-to-bottom transparent-to-dark gradient scrim to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Include haptic feedback mapped exactly as requested in the JSON. The tactile feel is crucial for a premium iOS-Native Clean app.
For the Service Request Form, ensure the primary submit button is sticky at the bottom of the screen (in a safe-area aware container with glassmorphism), not inline with the scrolling content.
Do NOT show any Emergent branding/logos anywhere as explicitly requested by the user.
